findings.evidence: Phrase: "A technology company told employees to stop using a rival chatbot at work." vs. the only supporting source's title: "Meta and Microsoft take steps to reduce employee usage of Claude AI" (snippet contains no article text beyond Hacker News engagement stats).
findings.suggestion: Soften to match the source's actual claim, e.g. "A technology company told employees to cut back on using a rival chatbot at work" or "...took steps to limit use of a rival chatbot at work," so the paraphrase doesn't escalate 'reduce usage' into an outright 'stop' directive.
